title: Concept: SHA-1 use via sha1 (php) — review required
description: In php, sha1 computes SHA-1. Public collision demonstrations ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity, though content addressing and legacy interop remain legitimate. The php-specific remedy is hash('sha256', ...).
applicability: php codebases hashing data through sha1; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged signatures and integrity values where SHA-1 guards trust; LOW default severity, raised when the digest is security-relevant.
